name: thermal-print-type
title: Thermal Print Type
description: Text emerges as if printed by a receipt printer: a hard clip line sweeps downward in steps while a dither mask fades in behind it, with the characteristic slight horizontal jitter of a misaligned head.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
